diagnosis.tuscany-ride: Vespi braked to a full stop for ~0.75 s at the loop point (frames 288–306 frozen at the same x) and the loop then jumped back ~4% of the width; seam frame difference 3× the median.
diagnosis.bologna: Ping-pong loop, 1280 px at ~400 kbit/s (soft and blocky on a 1440 laptop at 125%); seam jump 8× the median, stop-and-go inside.
diagnosis.belvedere: 1280 px at ~850 kbit/s, seam jump 2× the median.
diagnosis.plan-courtyard: Motion on twos in places (every other frame held), loud saturated colours.
